'''Ianane III''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose surface was completely covered by a deep layer of sand. The planet had violent [[Sandstorm/Legends|storms]] in its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and the brightness of its surface for a long [[Time/Legends|time]] caused it to be misidentified as a [[Star/Legends|star]]. Ianane III was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the ruins of the [[Ianane Ring]], believed to be constructed by the long-disappeared [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]].

==Description==
Ianane III was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Ianane system/Legends|Ianane system]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> Its surface was encased by a layer of [[Glass/Legends|glass]]-like sand hundreds of [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in depth. The razor-sharp sand particles gave rise to monstrous [[Sandstorm/Legends|storms]] in the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. [[Star/Legends|Sunlight]] reflected from the sand on Ianane III's surface resulted in the planet appearing [[Color/Legends|white]] from [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and being nearly as bright as its star.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==History==
The brightness of Ianane III's surface caused the<ref name="Author's Cut" /> Wild Space<ref name="EAOC" /> world to be misidentified for [[Time/Legends|ages]] as a [[Binary star/Legends|second star]] in its [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Travel to the Ianane system was made difficult by its location amidst a maze of [[Hyperspace anomaly/Legends|hyperspatial anomalies]], but for a long time those [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who returned alive from a visit to Ianane III nevertheless became fascinated by the unusual world.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Locations==
Ianane III was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by fragments of the [[Ring/Legends|ring]]-like [[Space station/Legends|structure]] known as the [[Ianane Ring]]. It was widely believed to be constructed by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> who had disappeared from the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The surface features of the Ianane Ring had at some point been reduced to black ash, which contrasted with the color of Ianane III's surface.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ianane III was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the planet was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Ianane III was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ianane system, and therefore Ianane III, in grid square I-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
